For each rating, average replacement cost and rental rate across film titles, treating rental rate as a price charged per day; compare the rating’s average rate with the plain average of the five rating-level rates

queries:
WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT
    rating,
    AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost,
    AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS avg_rate_per_day
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
)
SELECT
  rating,
  avg_replacement_cost,
  avg_rate_per_day / AVG(avg_rate_per_day) OVER () AS relative_rate_per_day
FROM rating_averages

WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT
    rating,
    AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost,
    AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(rental_duration) AS rental_rate_per_day
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
)
SELECT
  rating,
  avg_replacement_cost,
  rental_rate_per_day,
  (SELECT AVG(rental_rate_per_day) FROM rating_averages) AS avg_rating_rate_per_day
FROM rating_averages

WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT
    rating,
    AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost,
    AVG(rental_rate) AS avg_daily_rental_rate
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
)
SELECT
  rating,
  avg_replacement_cost,
  avg_daily_rental_rate,
  AVG(avg_daily_rental_rate) OVER () AS avg_rating_level_rate,
  avg_daily_rental_rate - AVG(avg_daily_rental_rate) OVER () AS difference_from_rating_level_avg
FROM rating_averages
ORDER BY rating

WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT
    f.rating,
    AVG(f.replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost,
    AVG(f.rental_rate * 1.0 / f.rental_duration) AS rental_rate_per_day
  FROM inventory AS i
  JOIN film AS f ON f.film_id = i.film_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
)
SELECT
  rating,
  avg_replacement_cost,
  rental_rate_per_day,
  (SELECT AVG(rental_rate_per_day) FROM rating_averages) AS avg_rating_rate_per_day
FROM rating_averages
ORDER BY rating

WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT
    f.rating,
    AVG(f.replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost,
    AVG(1.0 * f.rental_rate / f.rental_duration) AS avg_rental_rate_per_day
  FROM rental AS r
  JOIN inventory AS i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
  JOIN film AS f ON f.film_id = i.film_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
)
SELECT
  rating,
  avg_replacement_cost,
  avg_rental_rate_per_day,
  AVG(avg_rental_rate_per_day) OVER () AS plain_avg_rating_rate_per_day
FROM rating_averages
ORDER BY rating

WITH title_costs AS (
  SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
),
rating_rates AS (
  SELECT
    f.rating,
    AVG(f.rental_rate / (julianday(r.return_date) - julianday(r.rental_date))) AS avg_rate_per_elapsed_day
  FROM rental AS r
  JOIN inventory AS i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
  JOIN film AS f ON f.film_id = i.film_id
  WHERE r.return_date IS NOT NULL
    AND julianday(r.return_date) > julianday(r.rental_date)
  GROUP BY f.rating
)
SELECT
  tc.rating,
  tc.avg_replacement_cost,
  rr.avg_rate_per_elapsed_day,
  (SELECT AVG(avg_rate_per_elapsed_day) FROM rating_rates) AS five_rating_average,
  rr.avg_rate_per_elapsed_day
    - (SELECT AVG(avg_rate_per_elapsed_day) FROM rating_rates) AS difference_from_five_rating_average
FROM title_costs AS tc
JOIN rating_rates AS rr ON rr.rating = tc.rating
ORDER BY tc.rating
